name: Two Bays Walking Trail
objection: Linear trail overlapping Arthurs Seat and the national park; placement by midpoint.

name: Coastal Walk (Mornington Peninsula)
objection: Overlaps beach and lookout spots along the same cliffs; one source only.

name: Coppins Track
objection: Short track overlapping Sorrento Ocean Beach and the coastal walk; could be a duplicate.

name: Greens Bush
objection: For: a real nature draw. Against: one source and a local-feeling visit, part of the national park.

name: Flinders Blowhole
objection: Short visit; the blowhole depends on swell.

name: Mushroom Reef Marine Sanctuary
objection: For: a distinct activity. Against: one source, tide-dependent, next to Flinders Ocean Beach.

name: Gunnamatta Beach
objection: Dangerous surf and no swimming for most; Portsea and Sorrento back beaches are adjacent.

name: Portsea Surf Beach
objection: Dangerous surf and no swimming for most; Portsea and Sorrento back beaches are adjacent.

name: Sorrento Ocean Beach
objection: Dangerous surf and no swimming for most; Portsea and Sorrento back beaches are adjacent.

name: Sorrento Front Beach
objection: For: Sorrento's popular bay beach. Against: overlaps the Sorrento town spot, one source.

name: Fingal Beach
objection: For: second-tier beach. Against: no guide describes a draw, near Peninsula Hot Springs.

name: Rye Ocean Beach
objection: Another of several adjacent ocean beaches with little to separate them.

name: Portsea
objection: For: tip-of-peninsula resort village. Against: the surf beach is a separate candidate; a town wrapper.

name: Sorrento
objection: The beaches are separate candidates; town spot may duplicate them.

name: Western Port
objection: For: Ramsar wetland and birdlife. Against: no single visitor spot, overlaps French Island and Phillip Island.

name: The Briars
objection: Mainly a National Trust homestead; modest draw for non-locals.

name: McCrae Homestead
objection: For: heritage house open to the public. Against: one source, short visit, limited opening.

name: Peninsula Hot Springs
objection: Zero page views and a single counted source here, but it is the region's best-known attraction.

name: Alba Thermal Springs & Spa
objection: For: thermal pools open to the public. Against: a spa/business and near-duplicate of Peninsula Hot Springs.

name: Mornington
objection: For: harbour town stop. Against: a town wrapper over Mornington Pier, no named sight.

name: Mornington Railway
objection: For: a heritage railway, as COVERAGE allows when the ride is the attraction. Against: limited Sundays and a dead link on Wikivoyage.

name: Dromana Beach
objection: For: photogenic boat sheds. Against: a short visit, one source.

name: Bridgewater Bay
objection: For: distinct rock-pool bay. Against: one source, very local.

name: Red Hill Cheese
objection: For: a food stop named by Wikivoyage. Against: a shop-like venue with limited opening.

name: Phillip Island
objection: The island is a region-sized place that contains many other candidates; whether it is a spot or a destination is placement's call.

name: Penguin Parade
objection: Evening only and paid; the parade is nightly all year.

name: The Nobbies
objection: Shares a Wikivoyage entry with Seal Rocks.

name: Churchill Island
objection: Farmers market is occasional; the farm itself is the draw.

name: Cape Woolamai
objection: One counted source, but a headland walk and second-tier stop.

name: National Vietnam Veterans Museum
objection: Volunteer-run and niche; one source.

name: A Maze'N Things
objection: For: open daily and paid. Against: a commercial family venue, not a place travellers seek out.

name: Phillip Island Chocolate Factory
objection: For: a named stop with a paid attraction. Against: mainly a shop and cafe.

name: Purple Hen Wines
objection: For: tastings with views. Against: a cellar door/business.

name: Rhyll Inlet and Conservation Hill
objection: For: distinct nature stop. Against: a local reserve and a short visit.

name: French Island
objection: Needs a ferry and bike; the island is the spot, the ferry is not.

name: Fairhaven Northern Beach Walk
objection: For: named walks. Against: part of the French Island spot and one source each.

name: Old Coast Road Track
objection: For: named walks. Against: part of the French Island spot and one source each.

name: West Coast Wetlands Walking Track
objection: For: named walks. Against: part of the French Island spot and one source each.

name: Inverloch
objection: For: the main resort town on this coast. Against: a town wrapper; the Wikivoyage page gives no named sight.

name: State Coal Mine
objection: One counted source; a good heritage tour.
